problem.description: Local PyInstaller Windows artifact build crashes before COLLECT

findings: The crash occurs during PyInstaller's torchaudio hook after module analysis, with 8+ GB free on C and 492+ GB free on E.
The same crash occurs with only explicit smoke-tested dynamic imports, so bulk hidden imports are not the remaining cause.
Increasing the Python recursion limit from 5000 to 20000 did not prevent the native stack overflow.

resolution: Removed the incompatible distutils exclusion and built with tested Python 3.12.13; retain Python 3.10 crash evidence as a runtime-specific limitation. Clean runner verification remains required.
